title: Camelback retreat with pool, spa, golf & mtn views
description:
Private resort-style retreat at the base of iconic Camelback Mountain with a large private pool, jacuzzi, 3-hole putting green & spectacular 360° mountain views. Just minutes from Old Town Scottsdale, Fashion Square, world-class resorts, golf, dining, shopping & nightlife. 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths & spacious indoor/outdoor living make this an ideal getaway for families, friends, golf & corp groups. Wall Street Journal featured • Superhost • 4.97 stars • 260+ reviews.
